CustomField.description: The share of scored answers at 4 or 5, for a question on a five point scale (the worded scales and the 1 to 5 rating) whose scores all sit within 1 to 5. Blank for any other question.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: On a question scored 1 to 5, the share of answers scoring 4 or 5, such as Satisfied and Very Satisfied. Blank on any other question.
CustomField.label: Favorable
